description.tr: Bağdat'lı, edib bir kâtib, Mısır'a yerleşti ve orada vefat etti.
description.en: Litterateur scribe from Baghdad, settled in Egypt and died there.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. ʿAlī b. al-Husayn, Abū Muslim, known as the scribe of the vizier Abī al-Faḍl (Jaʿfar b. al-Faḍl) Ibn Hanzāba, also called Abū Muslim al-Kātib

tr: Muhammed b. Ahmed b. Ali b. el-Hüseyin, Ebû Müslim, Vezir Ebî'l-Fazl (Cafer b. el-Fazl) İbn Hanzâbe'nin kâtibi olarak tanınan, Ebû Müslim el-Kâtib diye de anılan
ar: محمد بن أحمد بن علي بن الحسين، أبو مسلم، المعروف بكاتب الوزير أبيالفضل (جعفر بن الفضل) ابن حنزابة، ويقال له أبو مسلم الكاتب

derived_from.edition_or_version: Khayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī, al-Aʿlām (Beirut: Dār al-ʿIlm li’l-Malāyīn, 8th ed. 2002), 8 vols.
